svg.title: Harvest quantity reconciliation and discrepancy preservation
svg.desc: A comparison of outgoing and receiving quantities showing that both attributable measurements remain preserved when they differ, with held or waste quantities accounted for and discrepancies escalated instead of edited to force a match.
svg.text: Quantity reconciliation: preserve the mismatch until it is resolved

g.text: Preserve both original attributable values → account for hold / waste / transfers → verify identity, units and method
→ document what is known and unknown → escalate unresolved difference → close only through the controlled process.
Do not overwrite, average, delete, or choose the number that makes the record balance.
A discrepancy is evidence to investigate. It is not permission to rewrite history.
